title: Inception & First Wings
summary: Airnova was founded by a passionate cohort of aeronautical and electronics engineering students with a shared ambition to master unmanned aerial systems.
details: Formed core subsystems: Aerodynamics, Propulsion, and Avionics.
Fabricated first balsa-wood glider and RC high-wing trainer aircraft.
Established foundational workshop safety and telemetry logging protocols.

title: Technical Expansion & Autonomy
summary: Transitioned into autonomous multi-rotor platforms and hybrid airframe architectures with custom flight controller firmware.
details: Integrated PX4 open-source autopilot for automated waypoint grid surveys.
Expanded committee structure to 8 specialized functional wings.

title: National Podiums & Biomimetic Research
summary: Achieved breakthrough podium rankings at national aerospace symposiums and launched the Biomimetic Flight Initiative.
details: 1st Place in Autonomous Navigation Challenge at National Drone Conclave.
First successful flight trials of bio-inspired flapping-wing Ornithopter prototypes.
Secured industry partnership grants for high-discharge propulsion test benches.

title: Next-Gen Fleet & Vertical Mobility
summary: Rolled out the 2025 Flagship Engineering Cohort featuring 7 advanced aircraft, including dual-mode VTOL, sounding rocketry, and wearable gesture UAVs.
details: Engineered transition flight mechanics for Tilt-Rotor VTOL prototype.
Integrated onboard Edge AI vision for real-time obstacle avoidance.
Prepared international competition entry portfolio with full EDR documentation.
